channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Game Off 2026: The theme is SHIFT
item.description: GitHub’s annual month-long game jam is back for its 14th year! This November, make a game inspired by the theme SHIFT. Change gears, swap perspectives, bend reality, or just press a certain key. (2 sources: githubblog, javascriptweekly)

item.title: Arnis turns any place on Earth into a Minecraft world
item.description: Louis Erbkamm built the first prototype in his free time. Now GitHub Copilot helps him maintain it alone. The post Arnis turns any place on Earth into a Minecraft world appeared first on The GitHub Blog . (1 source: githubblog)

item.title: LLVM Vulkan 1.1: Drop-in compiler passes (GVN, CSE, CFG, DCE) on Vulkan compute with benchmarks & Clang integration
item.description: Hey r/programming and r/Compilers , I've just released LLVM Vulkan 1.1 , an open-source project that moves beyond an experimental prototype into a drop-in pass plugin that accelerates LLVM middle-end passes using portable Vulkan compute… (1 source: rprogramming)

item.title: Introducing Zero Wire, a hub for investigating critical Internet vulnerabilities
item.description: Zero Wire on Cloudflare Radar pairs plain-language briefings with global attack telemetry and remediation steps. Triage critical CVEs faster and decide how to protect your infrastructure. (1 source: cloudflare)
